claim.statement: Existing aggregate state leaf serde is reused through generic Dynamic scalar/V3 known/shared routes, with Dynamic logical roles and physical names recognizing one aggregate data leaf. No serializer per recursive type product is added.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the measured eight-profile Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2 V3/BASIC-discriminator boundary; arbitrary compositions and remaining state families/layouts are not qualified.

trust.G: Four fixtures under two String profiles, five parent rows, marks [2,2,1] plus terminal zero; not all type products or layouts.
trust.R: Root executed tests/builds/native/audits and independently inspected delegated production/harness changes. Luna review is same-lineage correlated, not independent replication.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: runtime descriptor admission and persisted Dynamic known/shared layout.
boundaries.rollback: Revert the exact-path atomic local W226 commit; preserve unrelated work. No push, amend or remote history rewrite.
accepted: Existing static-admitted Count/Sum-family aggregate actuals in normal generic Dynamic values and V3 ordinary structures.
Generic Dynamic bulk known/shared encoding/decoding and existing paired part writer/readers, typed/generic callbacks, selected windows and detached owned values.
The measured native fixtures: known Count/shared Sum, shared-only cap zero, actual Array(Sum), outer Array(Dynamic), each in SingleStream/WithSizeStream.
retained_guards: Default shared-child helper remains closed to aggregate actuals; the permission propagates through hidden runtime Tuple(Dynamic) values.
JSON typed/runtime aggregate routes, Object shared aggregate envelopes and borrowed persisted Dynamic/aggregate states remain closed.
Legacy DynamicValueCodec keeps fixed public unions and explicitly rejects aggregate rosters/values.
Dynamic ordinary roster prohibitions, contextual static grammar and unsupported aggregate families/versions are unchanged.
not_claimed: All AggregateFunction state families, every recursive Cartesian product, Compact parts, COMPACT discriminators, sparse/custom serialization, Dynamic V1/V2/FLATTENED or mutable live parts.
Native whole-catalog/projection integration: owned-value witnesses use a synthetic offline catalog.
MV/projection write or execution semantics, aggregate finalization, PK expansion, broad facade cleanup, memory/performance or the <=10 percent read-gap goal.
Whole-repository test closure, full payload authentication of unselected shared scalar bodies, constructor-cost bounds or peak RSS.

architecture.law: Reuse leaf serde; compose wrapper stream names, child row domains, prefix/state and mark context. Scalar/RowBinary recursion does not alone certify MergeTree bulk layout.
changes: Contextual static admission replaces generic Dynamic constructor/structure blanket AF refusal.
BinaryCodecContext carries the selected runtime permission; generic Dynamic shared calls opt in without resetting the traversal/wire budget.
Four Dynamic logical role visitors and three physical visitors recognize one aggregate data leaf. AF argument descriptors remain nominal metadata, not value lanes.
Retained legacy and JSON/borrowed owners remain closed; existing static leaf codecs are unchanged.
failure_lineage: Baseline RED compiled but all ten examples hit the old constructor/roster rejection.
First candidate compiled: 39 focused examples, three bulk/writer errors because Dynamic logical roles omitted the aggregate leaf.
The bounded logical-role correction produced 41 passing focused examples.
architecture.strongest_failure: Writer and reader agree on misplaced state or wrong Count/Sum dispatch; root nominal checks miss hidden Dynamic runtime actuals in a closed owner.
controls: Independent stock-authored literals and native known/shared placement distinguish correlated writer/reader errors.
Count UInt64 maximum is VarUInt; Sum(UInt8)=256 is an eight-byte accumulator.
First-empty/ragged arrays, nulls, zero shared capacity and terminal zero marks retain distinct parent/flattened/selected row domains.
Exact-fit/one-short retained-owner refusal keeps all counters unchanged; cumulative node/edge/depth/wire guards are retained.
The compressed-frame corruption rejects before a typed callback; this is a transport, not raw state-semantic, mutation.
Successful-exit CHECK=0 with a matching case carrier and green summary is rejected by raw audit, then exact restoration passes.

source_reference.distinction: Source snapshot and runtime are separate pins; no same-build or perpetual latest-master claim.

anchors.law: Shared values contain a concrete type descriptor and ordinary selected serializer body.
Bulk prefix/version/state differs from per-value selected-type delegation; null and shared framing are explicit.
IColumn state serialization delegates to the aggregate function; Field's string envelope is a distinct context.
Count state uses VarUInt, not the Sum accumulator encoding.
Direct Dynamic/Variant/Nullable alternatives are prohibited independently of child leaf serde.

verification.execution_owner: Root; all compiler/native/Ruby jobs serialized through the unchanged run_safe memory/process guard.

check_zero_seed.scope: Raw stdout and case carrier changed coherently; process exit/status and summary remained green. Exact restoration was hash-checked. This qualifies audit refusal, not state corruption.

cross_mode_files.scope: Relative file paths/sizes/SHA-256 match; byte equality alone is not the native compatibility oracle.
